title: 第14章 生出不舍
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

次日天还没亮。

祁晏辞再次被体内那股燥热弄醒。

那热意像从骨缝里一点点渗出来，不猛烈，却磨人。

他睁开眼，眉心瞬间皱起，掀开被子下床。

沙发上的时夏禾睡得本就浅，听见动静，几乎立刻惊醒。

昨晚那一幕还在脑子里。

他没有焦距的眼睛，摸索床沿的动作……

她心口一紧，顾不上尴尬，坐起身轻声问：“祁先生，要我扶您过去吗？”

话音刚落，祁晏辞猛地看了过来。

那双眼睛已经恢复清明。

冷，锐，像淬了冰的刀锋。

时夏禾呼吸一滞。

他看得见了。

而且看得很清楚。

清楚到那一眼落在她身上，像能把她所有试探和小心思都剖开。

祁晏辞嗓音冷得没有半点温度。

“做你该做的，别自作聪明。”

时夏禾脸色微白，“……抱歉。”

祁晏辞没再理她，大步进了洗手间。

门关上的瞬间，时夏禾才慢慢吐出一口气。

所以，他是间歇性失明。

这种病症并不常见，她以前只在爷爷留下的医书里见过相似记载。

肝肾亏虚，瘀阻清窍，或旧伤压迫，都可能导致短暂视物不清。

可现实里，她还是第一次遇见。

正想着，浴室里忽然传来哗啦啦的水声。

时夏禾一怔。

这么早洗澡？

下一秒，她忽然想起，这两天她给祁晏辞煲的汤水里加了不少温补的东西。

原本是想替他补气养胃，缓一缓体虚的底子。

只是她当时不知道，祁晏辞真正的问题在眼睛，更不知道他的身体对外来调理这么敏感。

时夏禾后背一僵。

要是被祁晏辞知道，她在不清楚他病情的情况下自作主张给他食补，只怕会立刻把她赶出去。

时夏禾心顿时悬了起来。

她这份工作，大概真的保不住了。

上午，时夏禾依旧尽职尽责地陪在老爷子身边。

老爷子喜欢她，拉着她问了不少话。

她便耐心应着，偶尔说几句讨巧话，把老人哄得眉眼舒展。

祁晏辞一直坐在不远处。

话很少，神色也淡。

可时夏禾总觉得，他今天比昨天更冷，像隔着一层碰不得的冰。

中午过后，两人终于离开祁家。

车子驶出庄园。

一路上，祁晏辞都闭着眼靠在后座，没说一句话。

车厢里安静得压人。

时夏禾坐在旁边，背脊挺得很直。

她在等祁晏辞对这三天试用期下最后的判定。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It was still dark the next day.

Qi Yanci was awakened by the heat in his body again.

The heat seemed to seep out bit by bit from the cracks in the bones, not violent, but grinding.

He opened his eyes, frowned instantly, lifted the quilt and got out of bed.

Shi Xiahe, who was sleeping lightly on the sofa, woke up almost immediately when he heard the noise.

The scene last night is still in my mind.

His unfocused eyes, groping for the edge of the bed...

Her heart tightened, and she ignored the embarrassment. She sat up and asked softly: "Mr. Qi, do you want me to help you over?"

As soon as he finished speaking, Qi Yanci looked over suddenly.

Those eyes have regained their clarity.

Cold and sharp, like a blade tempered with ice.

Shi Xiahe's breathing stagnated.

He could see it.

And see it clearly.

It was so clear that when one look fell on her, it seemed like it could cut through all her temptations and little thoughts.

Qi Yanci's voice was so cold that there was no warmth at all.

“Do what you have to do and don’t be too smart.”

Shi Xiahe's face turned slightly pale, "...I'm sorry."

Qi Yanci ignored her and strode into the bathroom.

The moment the door closed, Shi Xiahe slowly let out a breath.

Therefore, he is intermittently blind.

This disease is not common. She had only seen similar records in the medical books left by her grandfather.

Deficiency of the liver and kidneys, blood stasis blocking the clearing of the orifices, or pressure from old injuries may lead to temporary blurred vision.

But in reality, this was the first time she met him.

Just as he was thinking about it, the sound of rushing water suddenly came from the bathroom.

Shi Xiahe was startled.

Taking a shower so early?

The next second, she suddenly remembered that she had added a lot of warming things to Qi Yanci's soup in the past two days.

Originally, I wanted to replenish his energy and nourish his stomach, so as to relieve his physical weakness.

But she didn't know at the time that Qi Yanci's real problem was his eyes, let alone that his body was so sensitive to external conditioning.

Shi Xiahe's back stiffened.

If Qi Yanci found out that she took it upon herself to give him food supplements without knowing his condition, he would probably kick her out immediately.

Shi Xia He's heart suddenly became anxious.

She probably can't keep her job.

In the morning, Shi Xiahe still stayed with the old man dutifully.

The old man liked her and asked her a lot.

She responded patiently, and occasionally said a few sweet words to make the old man's face relax.

Qi Yanci has been sitting not far away.

He speaks very little and has a calm expression.

But Shi Xiahe always felt that he was colder today than yesterday, like a layer of untouchable ice.

After noon, the two finally left Qi's house.

The car drove out of the manor.

Along the way, Qi Yanci leaned on the back seat with his eyes closed and didn't say a word.

The carriage was oppressively quiet.

Shi Xiahe sat next to him, his back straight.

She was waiting for Qi Yanci's final judgment on the three-day probation period.
